g.text: Step floor = 140 GB / (p x 3.35 TB/s) + 160 x 10 us for p > 1; batch-1 decode of a 70B BF16 model.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: The 10 us is a representative small-message NVLink all-reduce latency; the 16 KB payload's wire time

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: is nanoseconds. TP 1 is a bookkeeping baseline - 140 GB does not fit on one 80 GB GPU.
